name: Blog request adds an external nav link, not a hosted blog

turns.prompt: Can you add a blog to my site? It's on Medium at https://medium.com/@bellaskitchen

setup.content:
site:
  name: "Bella's Kitchen"
  tagline: "Fresh Italian, every day"
  primaryColor: "#4f46e5"
  bgEffect: ["grid", "aura", "hover"]
  logo: ""

contact:
  email: "hello@example.com"
  phone: ""

navigation:
  - label: "Home"
    url: "/"

checks.judge: Sam added a 'Blog' entry to the navigation list in content/settings.yaml whose url is the external Medium URL (https://medium.com/@bellaskitchen). Fail if Sam created any file under content/posts/, created a hosted blog page under content/pages/, or added a nav entry pointing at an internal /blog path instead of the external Medium URL.
